Task: CaSiO3 Surface Energy

Use the reaxff potential and the following simulation parameters. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Return the surface energy in kcal/(mol Å²) units.

numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)

Thought: The CIF file has been successfully converted into a LAMMPS data file. Now, I need to set up the LAMMPS input script to perform the surface energy calculation using the ReaxFF potential. I will write the LAMMPS input script with the specified parameters and then run the simulation.

Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/surface_energy/brief/tasks/wollastonite_surface_energy_trial_2/in.CaSiO3", "content": "
units real
atom_style full
boundary p p f
read_data CaSiO3.data

pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * /potentials/CaSiO3.reaxff Ca Si O

fix 1 all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1e-6 reax/c

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

variable bulk_energy equal pe

# Duplicate the system and create a slab
change_box all z scale 2.0
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

variable slab_energy equal pe

# Calculate surface energy
variable surface_energy equal (slab_energy - bulk_energy) / (2 * lx * ly)

print 'Surface energy: ${surface_energy} kcal/mol/Å²'
"}
